The steps are:

2. Calculate monthly averages for 2019 and 2020
3. Calculate the growth rate from 2019 to 2020
4. Project 2021 sales using the growth rate
5. Convert to USD using the currency table
6. Calculate monthly averages for 2021 in USD
7. Find the median of these monthly averages

args.sql:
WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT 
        s.time_id,
        s.amount_sold
    FROM complex_oracle.main.sales s
    JOIN complex_oracle.main.customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN complex_oracle.main.promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
    JOIN complex_oracle.main.channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52779
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.time_id) IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
),
monthly_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM time_id) AS month,
        AVG(amount_sold) AS avg_2019
    FROM sales_data
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM time_id) = 2019
    GROUP BY month
),
monthly_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM time_id) AS month,
        AVG(amount_sold) AS avg_2020
    FROM sales_data
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM time_id) = 2020
    GROUP BY month
),
growth_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        m1.month,
        (m2.avg_2020 - m1.avg_2019) / m1.avg_2019 AS growth_rate
    FROM monthly_2019 m1
    JOIN monthly_2020 m2 ON m1.month = m2.month
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        (avg_2020 * (1 + growth_rate)) AS projected_amount
    FROM monthly_2020 m2
    JOIN growth_rate g ON m2.month = g.month
),
monthly_averages_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        AVG(projected_amount) AS avg_monthly_projected
    FROM projected_2021
    GROUP BY month
),
monthly_averages_2021_usd AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        AVG(projected_amount) * TRY_CAST(cr.to_us AS DOUBLE) AS avg_monthly_projected_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    JOIN complex_oracle.main.currency cr ON 
        cr.country = 'France' 
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.month) = cr.year
        AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.month) = cr.month
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
    MEDIAN(avg_monthly_projected_usd) AS median_avg_monthly_projected_usd
FROM monthly_averages_2021_usd
